content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To decorate a carrot cake, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Whip the heavy cream for the topping (5 minutes)
Step 2. Print out a reference photo for the design (2 minutes)
Step 3. Apply the final layer of smooth frosting (15 minutes)
Step 4. Sift the powdered sugar for the buttercream (10 minutes)
Step 5. Dye a small portion of frosting bright orange (3 minutes)
Step 6. Beat the butter until fluffy (8 minutes)
Step 7. Mix the vanilla extract into the frosting base (1 minute)
Step 8. Assemble the cake layers with filling (12 minutes)
Step 9. Chill the mixing bowl (20 minutes)
Step 10. Toast the chopped pecans (10 minutes)
Step 11. Pipe small carrot shapes onto the cake (10 minutes)
Step 12. Combine the butter and sugar (5 minutes)
Step 13. Soften the cream cheese at room temperature (1 hour)
Step 14. Level the cake layers with a serrated knife (10 minutes)
Step 15. Prepare the piping bags with tips (5 minutes)
Step 16. Press crushed walnuts onto the sides of the cake (8 minutes)
Step 17. Organize the decorating turntable and spatulas (5 minutes)
Step 18. Cool the pecans completely (15 minutes)
Step 19. Fold the whipped cream into the frosting (4 minutes)
Step 20. Sieve the orange food coloring to remove clumps (2 minutes)
Step 21. Grind a portion of the pecans into fine dust (4 minutes)
Step 22. Clean the workstation (15 minutes)
Step 23. Place the cake on the final serving board (2 minutes)
Step 24. Sketch the layout of the carrots on paper (5 minutes)
Step 25. Blend the cream cheese until smooth (6 minutes)
Step 26. Grate fresh nutmeg for a garnish (3 minutes)
Step 27. Whip the cream cheese and butter together (7 minutes)
Step 28. Purchase fresh ingredients from the store (1 hour)
Step 29. Zest an orange for flavor (3 minutes)
Step 30. Measure out the confectioners' sugar (5 minutes)
Step 31. Set aside frosting for the decorative accents (2 minutes)
Step 32. Practice the piping technique on parchment (10 minutes)
Step 33. Sterilize the reusable piping tips (10 minutes)
Step 34. Soften the butter for the frosting (45 minutes)
Step 35. Prepare the orange-tinted icing (5 minutes)
Step 36. Sift a dusting of cinnamon over the frosting (1 minute)
Step 37. Unpack the baking supplies (10 minutes)
Step 38. Calibrate the kitchen scale (2 minutes)
Step 39. Apply a thin crumb coat to the cake (20 minutes)
Step 40. Mix the orange zest into the batter (2 minutes)
Step 41. Whisk the sugar to remove lumps (3 minutes)
Step 42. Prepare a sugar syrup for moisture (10 minutes)
Step 43. Retrieve the cake layers from the fridge (1 minute)
Step 44. Measure the height of the cake layers (2 minutes)
Step 45. Dye a small portion of frosting green for the leaves (3 minutes)
Step 46. Check the expiration date on the food coloring (1 minute)
Step 47. Slice the cake into even horizontal rounds (15 minutes)
Step 48. Take the eggs and butter out of the fridge (30 minutes)
Step 49. Pipe green stems onto the carrot decorations (8 minutes)
Step 50. Prepare the green frosting bag (4 minutes)
Step 51. Fill any gaps between the cake layers (10 minutes)
Step 52. Beat the cream cheese frosting until airy (6 minutes)
Step 53. Test the consistency of the green icing (2 minutes)
Step 54. Brush away loose crumbs from the cake (3 minutes)
Step 55. Melt a small amount of white chocolate (5 minutes)
Step 56. Clean the mixing paddles (5 minutes)
Step 57. Beat the cream cheese on high speed (4 minutes)
Step 58. Load the green frosting into the piping bag (3 minutes)
Step 59. Sprinkle the nutmeg over the finished cake (1 minute)
Step 60. Clear the kitchen counter (10 minutes)
